metadata.description: Comma-separated full resource IDs of target resource groups. The Automation identity receives Virtual Machine Contributor on each group, including groups in other accessible subscriptions.

Initial storage mode for Ghost NIC Hunter Automation variables. Keep enabled to satisfy encryption policies; disable only when operators must read values in the portal. Existing variables must be deleted and recreated to change modes.
Deployment timestamp used to give each one-time schedule bootstrap job a unique resource name.
Run confirmed ghost-NIC removal from the daily schedule. Leave disabled for detection-only deployments.
Restart a VM after scheduled removal reports that a restart is required. Used only when scheduled removal is enabled.
Create an hourly catch-up schedule that processes online VMs whose last completed Ghost NIC result is stale.
Number of hours between opportunistic catch-up runs.
Age in hours after which an online VM becomes eligible for opportunistic catch-up.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: Safety ceiling for confirmed ghost NIC candidates on one VM.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicExclusionTagName
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: VM tag used to exclude scanning or removal.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicPnpCleanWaitSeconds
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: Seconds to wait after PnpClean before pnputil fallback.
